info.title: Commons API
info.description: JSON over HTTPS plus one WebSocket (`/v1/socket`) per client.

get.summary:
Where the provider sends the browser back. Every outcome with a known flow redirects to
the app; an unknown, used or expired state gets a page, because there's nowhere to go.

403.description: registration is closed, or an invite is required, invalid, expired, used, revoked or made for a different email address

post.summary: Always answers 202 so the endpoint does not reveal which emails have accounts.

Upload a file to a conversation. The request body is the file's bytes, streamed to the
store; the file becomes visible only once complete. Attach it by id when sending.

get.summary:
Current members of a conversation: open membership intervals of current workspace
members, with their workspace profile. Only someone who can read it now may list them.

post.summary: Adds a workspace member to a channel or group DM. Anyone who can read it may add people.

delete.summary:
Removes someone's membership of a channel. Owners and admins, or the member themself.
Nobody removes someone else from a DM or group DM; they can only leave.

get.summary: History for backfill, newest first, including tombstones.

post.summary: Send a message. Resending with the same `client_id` returns the first result.

get.summary:
Download a file. Access is checked on every request; a download already streaming when
access is revoked finishes.
A PNG thumbnail of an image file, under the same access check as the file.

post.summary: Joins the signed-in user to the invite's workspace.

403.description: the invite is invalid, expired, used or revoked, or was made for a different email address

post.summary:
What an invite is for, before anyone signs in: read-only, and without the locks an
accept takes. Every kind of refusal looks the same.

403.description: the invite is invalid, expired, used or revoked

delete.summary: Unlinks an identity, unless it is the account's only way to sign in.

403.description: the last way to sign in

post.summary: Creates a workspace with a default `#general` channel; the caller becomes its owner.

get.summary: Members with their join dates and whether they are connected, for owners and admins.

Channels the caller can see: every public channel (except for guests) and the private
channels they can read.

post.summary:
Creates a public or private channel; the creator joins it. Owners and admins get
role-derived access to a private channel in the same transaction.
Opens (or returns) the DM or group DM between the caller and `user_ids`.
Adds an existing account to the workspace. Owners and admins only.

delete.summary:
Removes someone from the workspace: every access interval closes, and the user's own
stream gets `workspace_removed`, which drives their client's purge.

patch.summary: Changes a member's role. Only an owner grants or removes owner, and the last owner stays.

get.summary:
Search messages, file names and extracted file text in a workspace. Covers joined
channels and DMs, plus public channels for members who are not guests. CJK text is not
segmented in v1.

AcceptInvite.description: Accepts an invite as the signed-in user: an invite token, or the whole link.

AccessVia.description: Why a user can read a conversation over an interval.

AdminMember.description: A workspace member as owners and admins see them.

online.description: Connected to this server node now.

dm_user_ids.description: Members of a DM or group DM, so clients can title it. Empty for channels.

name.description: Channel name; `None` for DMs and group DMs.

CreateInvite.description: Creates a single-use invite to a workspace for one email address. Owners and admins only.

email.description: Only an account with this email can use the invite.

expires_in_days.description: Days until it expires: 1 to 30, 7 by default.

Entity.description: A structured entity stored beside the Markdown text. Offsets are UTF-8 byte offsets into `body`.

IdentityList.description: The caller's ways to sign in.

email.description:
The email it is for, normalised. None on invites made before invites had one; those
are not valid.

InviteCreated.description: A new invite. The token is shown this once; the server keeps only its hash.

link.description: `<public_url>/invite#<token>`; the token is in the fragment, which browsers never send.

email_masked.description: The invited address with most of its local part hidden, such as `ad•••@gmail.com`.

oneOf.description: The server's sign-in provider, as in [`Meta`], so the app needn't ask separately.

InvitePreviewRequest.description:
Asks what an invite is for, before anyone signs in. The token is in the body so it stays
out of request lines and access logs.

client_id.description: Client-generated UUIDv7 the server deduplicates on.

created_seq.description: Workspace seq of the event that created the message.

encryption.description: Reserved for encrypted DMs; always `None` in v1.

revision.description: Bumped by every edit and by delete. Edits must name the revision they were based on.

updated_seq.description: Workspace seq of the last change to this message, including reactions.

MessagePage.description: A page of conversation history, served for backfill.

interval_seq.description: Echo of the access interval the page was requested for.

next_before_seq.description: Pass as `before_seq` for the next page; `None` when history is exhausted.

oneOf.description: Set when the server offers sign-in through an OIDC provider.

preview.description: Plain-text preview, already checked against the recipient's current access.

OidcExchange.description: Exchanges the handoff code from the return redirect, with the verifier for its challenge.

oneOf.description: A sign-in: a new session for the account.
A link: the caller's identities, including the new one.

name.description: The provider's name for the button, as in "Continue with Google".

OidcStart.description:
Starts an OIDC sign-in. The app opens `authorize_url` in the system browser; the browser
comes back to `return_to` with `code`, or with `error` and `message`.

code_challenge.description: The app's PKCE challenge for the handoff: base64url(SHA-256(verifier)), unpadded.

invite.description: An invite token or link, for a new account in invite mode.

link.description: Link the provider identity to the signed-in caller instead of signing in.

return_to.description: A loopback address the app listens on, `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<path>` (RFC 8252).

channel_level.description: Default level for channels. DMs always notify unless muted.

invite.description: An invite token or link. Required when the server's registration mode is `invite`.

author_id.description: Author of the message, or of the message that carries the file.

conversation_name.description: Channel name, so hits in public channels the user has not joined can be titled.

snippet.description: Snippet text; matched terms are wrapped in U+0002 … U+0003. Render as text only.

thread_root_id.description: Set when the hit is a thread reply.

client_id.description: Client-generated UUIDv7; resending the same id does nothing.

oneOf.description: The user joined a workspace. Resume its stream from `start_seq - 1`.
The user was removed from a workspace. The client purges it.

workspaces.description: Each workspace with the seq its stream should resume after.

oneOf.description: A public channel was created; visible to every workspace member.
An access interval opened. `has_access` is the user's access after the change.
An access interval closed. When `has_access` is false the subject's client purges.
Tombstone: the message with body and entities cleared.
Present when `since` was before the prune point; replay continues after `snapshot.seq`.

WorkspaceSnapshot.description: What a user can read in a workspace at watermark `seq`.

conversations.description: Conversations the user can read at `seq`.
